label: Locate discriminating input in agenda selection and compare motivated choice
summary: At 561ba7d5 mapped complete proposed selection inputs into the existing noUnique selector obstruction and WholeSeriesChoicePolicies agenda certificate. A transported agenda changes the complete input; equal option value alone does not fix it. Preserved the moved-output condition, genuinely distinct outcome requirement, and the difference between a symmetric distribution and a unique realization. Clarke Fifth Reply §§1–20 supplies a positive motivated-agency comparison; no source claim or formal attribution added. Distinguished reasons to act, contrastive reasons and actual practical governance. The agenda explains a procedure under its order, while its authority and any divine application remain open; nonnecessitating agency is neither refuted nor identified with chance. At ec72649fb completed the #1570 governance test in docs/notes/explanatory-symmetry-742.md under Did the reason guide production of this order?. Matched dispatches separate a content-derived instruction used in production from an independent booking rule with the same later report; only the former stops on disconnect. A direct impersonal selector survives a correction of the booking just as the edited route does. At a tie the end warrants either eligible output. Actual basing and object-specific adoption motivate a conditional authorship advantage. Both productive origins can improve on brute actuality under whole-order explanation; identifying a rational power leaves its operative apprehended specification at this exercise open. The next discriminator is a same-giver constitutive account against common-source contemplation and value-sensitive production. No new result, premise closure or personality inference. Applied the reviewed dispatch comparison to Darwin abandoning the marine-origin claim for the Parallel Roads. The new Glen Roy section compares two sources of this very embodied knower’s continued existence, with identical geological and local rational resources. A finite terrain/report construction separates evidential uptake from a forced answer and operative specification from independent productivity at a contemplating source. Contemporaneous selective engagement favors basing. Neither the correction nor the identity of the power decides whether the giver sustained Darwin for his own epistemic good. The earlier published assessment at b559b9d12da12d91f44f093740eb81b38f562927 covers the dispatch only.

current_assessment.scope: The #1570 application to Charles Darwin correcting his marine-origin claim about the high shelves of Glen Roy. Compare the grounds of his continued existence, the evidence for his revision, and the proposed purpose of this very giving.
current_assessment.assessment: The ice-flow report answered a drainage objection. Darwin weighed different points from the same correspondent differently and later credited the reply to his difficulties. This favors actual evidential engagement. Embodied continuity and content-sensitive reasoning explain the local correction under either origin. Purposive giving could explain why Darwin himself was sustained for his good, if the same source’s apprehension specified this exercise. His correction supplies no discriminating evidence for that adoption over independent productivity, even at a source contemplating that same good.
current_assessment.next_test: At fixed giver, recipient, apprehended good and successful outcome, test whether the exemplar account of the actual giving can derive a recipient-directed practical object from the giver’s operation without presupposing adoption. The independently operating power can preserve the same individual and realize the same good. On strict intrinsic invariance, identify what grounds the determinate practical relation to this contingent recipient.

The note links the 1839 paper, 1861–62 testimony and independent modern geology, and contains the executable finite comparison. The earlier independent challenge at b559b9d12da12d91f44f093740eb81b38f562927 accepted the dispatch comparison only.
